Name: Portrait Frame Variations - Dynamic Seasonal Portrait UI
Author: ItsBenter
Description:
[left][b][/b][size=2][b]﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/LQeyWhM.png[/img][/b]
This mod adds a total of 113 portrait frame variations:[/size][list]
[*][size=2]45 seasonal (regular days, berry bearing days, and green rain)[/size]
[*][size=2]15 festivals[/size]
[*][size=2]42 maps[/size]
[*][size=2]10 events[/size]
[*][size=2]1 wedding[/size]
[/list][size=2]Frames to display can be configured to your heart liking and can also be set to not change dynamically (in case you like one sooo... much).

All frames are arranged from Stardew Valley assets in hope they aesthetically fit the game.
Detailed frames grouping and some config explanations can be found on [url=https://github.com/itsbenter/PortraitFrameVariations]Mod Repository[/url]﻿.

[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6[/url]﻿. To use same dialogue's portrait frame for farmer and character, set 'Use Custom Background' to false in that mod.[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Option to not overlay 'Galdoran Theme' is set to true by default.[/size]
[*][size=2]UI Recolor. On most case, this mod will overlay (draw on top) the UI mods, it has "Late + 500" priority. Generally you can use this mod and UI Recolor mod. However, how the two visuals will blend is a different subject and should be judged by yourself. There are some examples of how this mod fits with UI Recolor on [url=https://github.com/itsbenter/PortraitFrameVariations/?tab=readme-ov-file#faq]here[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19513]Changing Skies[/url]. Built-in edit will be used automatically, thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url] for the initiative. All edited assets can be seen [url=https://github.com/itsbenter/PortraitFrameVariations/blob/main/Documentation/ChangingSkies.md]here[/url]﻿.[/size]

1. Is it safe to add this mod mid-save?
This is a retexture mod. It should be pretty safe to add to and or remove from any save.

2. Can I use this mod in multiplayer?
Yes, you can! Even if it's only you that installed this mod, it would still work (Only you would see the mod in action though)

3. Is this mod compatible with that mod?
Most definitely compatible if the other mod doesn't touch dialogue's portrait frame.

Downloads.Description:
Install by unzipping the file in mod folder. If you have 1.4.1 version installed before, delete the "PortraitFrameVariations/Mod Page" folder to remove the yellow text on SMAPI console.
Edited 5 frames and removed unnecessary mod page on the zip.
